name: 4d-blog-engine
description: 4D Blog Engine — operationalizes the 4D AI Fluency Framework (Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence) for content production. The plugin is hard-wired to Payload CMS as the publishing backend. v0.3.1 decouples the plugin from any particular Payload site's brand: the hero-image flow now reads brand_style (palette, style keywords, forbidden elements, dimensions) from each project's blog-project-instructions.md instead of hardcoding one site's spec, drops the frontier-founder/blog-post dependency, and adds a brand-style step to /blog-init. v0.3.0 rewrote /blog-init to use the native OS folder picker for directory selection (no typed paths), dropped the static-site-generator question (Payload only), auto-detects Payload collections from payload.config.*, and captures Payload API base URL + auth mode in blog-project-instructions.md (schema v2). v0.2.0 added the /blog-init, /blog-start, /publish lifecycle. Pipeline: takes a base document and an angle question; runs a 30-day discourse sweep across reddit, X, Hacker News, Substack, Facebook, Quora, podcasts, and academic sources; layers a /council:deliberate synthesis pass; builds a verified bibliography with AI-generated abstracts; drafts the blog post in the configured voice using the existing research-pipeline + editorial-forge skills; runs a two-tier anti-AI-slop pass (deterministic linter + LLM structural review with a second-pass audit); and ships through a nonce-bound Release Owner Gate scoring against a 100-point rubric. On a clean gate, produces a publication-ready blog post, a long-form LinkedIn article (full mirror, blog stays canonical), and a short hook-led LinkedIn teaser with a 3-axis scorecard. Trigger phrases: 'write a blog post from this document', 'derive a blog from this whitepaper', '/4d-blog-engine', 'set up the blog plugin', 'publish this post', 'release-owner gate'. Implements the Release Owner Gate from MoxyWolf's 'Beyond the Prompt' whitepaper.
